title: no parent_cids count limit per log entry (amplification vector)
description: append.rs iterates over entry.parent_cids with no upper bound. An adversary could craft a log entry with thousands of parent CIDs, causing O(n) DB lookups per parent, O(n) SQL inserts in insert_entry, and O(n) BFS enqueue in backfill. backfill.rs also has no per-entry parent count limit. Add MAX_PARENT_CIDS = 100 and validate len <= MAX_PARENT_CIDS in both verify_entry() and append().
